Model strength changes the image model; text strength changes matching CLIP layers when the LoRA includes them. Set both to zero to disable it. SD 1.5, Flux and Qwen LoRAs are incompatible.
cap_juggernaut_xl_v9_is_an_sdxl_fine_tun: Juggernaut XL v9 is an SDXL fine-tune geared toward photographic rendering. It shares SDXL LoRAs and uses its own 35-step, CFG 5 defaults. Review the result before making a mesh.

cap_edit_or_reinterpret_uploaded_images_: Edit or reinterpret uploaded images. A source is required; its 40-step default can be considerably slower. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_the_larger_klein_base_model_with_20_: The larger Klein base model with 20-step sampling and adjustable guidance; allow more time and memory. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_a_larger_four_step_image_model_its_m: A larger four-step image model. Its model and text encoder use more memory than Klein 4B. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_reference_editing_variant_with_refer: Reference-editing variant with reference caching. Use it when working from supplied images; correct angles remain unguaranteed. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_fast_four_step_starting_choice_for_c: Fast four-step starting choice for creating and editing images on this 16 GB system. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_klein_4b_with_more_sampling_control_: Klein 4B with more sampling control; its 20-step default takes longer than the distilled version. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_flux_3_with_50_step_base_sampling_an: FLUX 3 with 50-step base sampling and adjustable guidance; use a full description and allow more time. Review the result before making a mesh.
cap_create_or_edit_from_a_full_descripti: Create or edit from a full description of the finished image, using the distilled 16-step default. Review the result before making a mesh.
